title: Entanglement degradation in regular and singular spacetimes
summary: We study entanglement degradation near the horizons of regular, Reissner-Nordström, and Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes, considering the Bardeen, Hayward, and generalized Hayward metrics as regular black holes. To this end, we compute the entanglement negativity, $\mathcal{N}$, for two Unruh-like modes of a scalar field shared by Alice, who is inertial, and Rob, who hovers at a fractional offset $ρ$ outside the horizon of the backgrounds under consideration.
